title: thymus hyemalis var. tenuifolius
intro: Thymus hyemalis var. tenuifolius, commonly known as Alpine Thyme, is a plant species in the mint family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used to support immune function and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its potential health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Thyme include flavonoids, terpenes, and volatile oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
